emma_mktg: Heads-up: we're scheduling the 'Inference Cost Playbook' blog for publish tomorrow 9:00 AM PT. Need final PR copy, exec quote, and embargo list.
oliver_pr: Copy. Send me the one-line angle for the press release. Also confirm embargo time.
emma_mktg: Embargo until 9:00 AM PT. Angle: 'Redwood Inference publishes a practical playbook showing how engineering teams cut LLM inference costs without sacrificing latency.'
maria_eng: I've uploaded charts and methodology notes to /shared/benchmarks/cost-playbook. Use `export_figs.sh` for high-res. Method blurb: 'Benchmarked three model families across two GPUs; measured p99 latency, throughput, and cost/token with typical batching and caching settings.'
oliver_pr: Please approve the CEO quote below: "Our goal is to shrink the gap between experimental models and production economics."
ceo_kevin: Edit: prefer "production operating economics" instead of "production economics". Approve with that wording.
oncall_support: Support will monitor for 3 hours after publish. Share the internal FAQ and Slack triage channel when ready.
ci-bot: CMS deploy job queued: job_id=costplaybook-202505, scheduled_time=1755601200, embargo=true.
emma_mktg: Timeline: assets done, CEO quote approved, embargo email scheduled for 4:30 PM PT, CMS scheduled for 9:00 AM PT. I'll post final 'ready' at 4:15 PM PT.
oliver_pr: I'll send embargo to press list at 4:30 and offer interviews.
ceo_kevin: Great work team. :rocket:
